sights.address: 10 Trần Phú, Phường 1, Vũng Tàu, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
sights.w: A colonial villa built 1898–1902 for Governor-General Paul Doumer on the old Phước Thắng Fortress hill, later a retreat for Emperor Bảo Đại and a place of exile for Emperor Thành Thái. A national historical relic (1992) overlooking Front Beach, now housing an antiques collection.

sights.address: off Mũi Nghinh Phong / Bãi Sau, Phường 2, Vũng Tàu, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
sights.w: A tiny rocky islet crowned by a small temple locals hold sacred; at low tide a natural stone causeway surfaces so you can walk out from the shore. A quiet sunrise and spiritual spot — time it carefully or the rising tide strands you.

sights.address: Quang Trung / Trần Phú promenade, Bãi Trước, Vũng Tàu, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
sights.w: Vũng Tàu's crescent-bay waterfront between Big and Small Mountain — a palm-lined promenade for sunset strolls, seafood and coconuts, ringed by landmarks (Bạch Dinh, the cable-car station, Phước Thắng Fortress). The city's social heart, quieter than Back Beach.

sights.address: 608 Trần Phú, Núi Lớn, Phường 5, Vũng Tàu, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
sights.w: A five-hectare Theravada Buddhist complex on the northwest slope of Big Mountain, built 1961–1963: a 10m+ golden seated Buddha among pines and a 17m octagonal reliquary tower holding relics and sacred earth from Buddhist holy sites. Designated a national relic in 1989.

sights.n: Nhà Lớn Long Sơn (Đền Ông Trần)
sights.address: Long Sơn commune (Núi Nứa island), Vũng Tàu, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
sights.w: A one-of-a-kind 2-hectare wood-and-tile temple compound on Long Sơn island, built 1910–1929 by Lê Văn Mưu ('Ông Trần'), founder of a local folk faith blending Confucianism and Taoism. Temple, mausoleum and communal halls with a century-old tamarind tree; a national relic and the island's living heritage site.

sights.address: Đường Dinh Cô, Long Hải, Long Điền, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
sights.w: A seaside shrine on Long Hải beach to a 19th-century maiden revered as a sea goddess, and site of the Dinh Cô Festival (10th–12th of the 2nd lunar month) — a Mother-Goddess worship rite recognised as National Intangible Cultural Heritage, with boat processions, lion dances and beach games.

sights.n: Bình Châu Hot Springs (Suối khoáng nóng Bình Châu)
sights.address: Bình Châu, Xuyên Mộc, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
sights.w: Southern Vietnam's only natural hot mineral springs — 70-plus surface vents from 37°C up to a boiling 82°C, set in the Bình Châu–Phước Bửu coastal forest with soaking pools, mud baths and an egg-boiling spring. A classic overnight on the Hồ Tràm–Hồ Cốc coast road.

sights.address: Bưng Riềng, Xuyên Mộc, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
sights.w: One of the most pristine beaches near Saigon — several kilometres of white sand backed by the Bình Châu–Phước Bửu forest, with clear water, big boulders and cheap fresh seafood. Reached on the scenic Ocean Road from Hồ Tràm, about 20 minutes from Bình Châu hot springs.

sights.address: Hồ Tràm, Phước Thuận, Xuyên Mộc, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
sights.w: A long, quiet arc of fine sand and clear water between Long Hải and Bình Châu, ~125 km from HCMC — casuarina-lined, cheap seafood at the fishing hamlet, and the anchor of the coast's cluster of beach resorts and golf courses. With Hồ Cốc, the best beach within easy reach of Saigon.

sights.address: Bình Châu / Bưng Riềng, Xuyên Mộc, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
sights.w: An 11,293-hectare protected coastal rainforest — the region's only surviving lowland dipterocarp forest — wrapping the Hồ Tràm and Hồ Cốc beaches and the Bình Châu hot springs. Home to the 136m Núi Hồ Linh hill and endangered species; hiking trails through a rare intact ecosystem.

sights.n: Khu Du Lịch Sinh Thái Bò Cạp Vàng
sights.address: Ấp 3, Phước Khánh, Nhơn Trạch, Đồng Nai, Vietnam
sights.w: An 8-hectare riverside ecotourism park on a former Sác-forest island in Nhơn Trạch, ~30 km from HCMC — river swimming and boat rides, team-building and camping, and rustic local dishes (clay-pot chicken, grilled snakehead). Nominated among Vietnam's top-7 impressive eco-resorts in 2024.
